items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Well Sy and Charlie and then another one, I can’t think of his name, a nephew, handled one of the big singers

ctx.x: And that name comes up a lot.

Sy Shribman. Well Sy and Charlie and then another one, I can’t think of his name, a nephew, handled one of the big singers I can’t remember now but another Shribman. Out of Boston. Well they broke the Blue Devils. They were the ones — well we picked up Les Brown in Boston.

Can you recall some of the Glenn Miller tunes that when you first played them, when the arrangements were first brought in, that the guys in the band were thinking, this is going to be a hot number? Were there any particular tunes that stood out?
